The GNU Compiler Collection version 13.5 has been released.

GCC 13.5 is a bug-fix release from the GCC 13 branch
containing important fixes for regressions and serious bugs in
GCC 13.4 with more than 265 bugs fixed since the previous release.

This is also the last release from the GCC 13 branch, GCC continues
to be maintained on the GCC 14, GCC 15 and GCC 16 branches and the
development trunk.

This release is available from the FTP servers listed here:

  https://gcc.gnu.org/pub/gcc/releases/gcc-13.5.0/
  https://gcc.gnu.org/mirrors.html

Please do not contact me directly regarding questions or comments
about this release.  Instead, use the resources available from
http://gcc.gnu.org.

As always, a vast number of people contributed to this GCC release
-- far too many to thank them individually!
